Profiled in headless Chromium: boot 5154ms, household switch blocking 239-1468ms, dashboard() 1500ms, masterView() 1016ms, paint() 1618ms. HANDOVER v21_656 (raised by Bhavya). (1) SPEED — the concurrency gate was pinned at 2 because of the old Apps Script quota crash, but v2 answers in ~2s and Google allows ~30 concurrent, so the cap is now 6 with much tighter step delays, the per-house sweep starts 6x sooner, and the day you are looking at is enriched FIRST. (2) MULTI-DISH LINES STILL COMBINING — the splitter only ran inside the enrichment job builder, so any line that was already enriched or served from cache never got split. The video is now only used when the Rasoi title genuinely overlaps the dish asked for (word-overlap >= 0.5); otherwise the chip falls back to a YouTube SEARCH for the real dish name and the source line shows a "different dish" warning so the mismatch is visible rather than silent. Verified: mismatched dish gets yt="" plus the warning, matching dish keeps its real video link.

SMART LIST v3 REBUILT AND UNLOCKED (v21_700, Bhavya). Model: pick a check-day D (chips Mon-Sun, defaults to today) -> D’s meals are SIMULATED against the live board in memory only (nothing persisted, D is not closed) -> the projected end-of-D stock is compared with D+1’s EVERY ingredient. Five sections: NEED TO ORDER FOR SURE (required for D+1, none on board or finished by D), GENUINELY LOW (some, but short or with thin buffer), D ITSELF CAN’T BE MADE (today’s meals exceed current stock), LEFTOVERS TO CHECK (items D’s cooking should exhaust — confirm nothing left behind), ENOUGH FOR D+1 ✓. Pantry items with no board row (spices/grains/dals) are folded into one collapsed line rather than cluttering "order". Ingredient breakdown: recipe-layer needs when present, else derived from dish text via the PP synonym families (so "cut pear" on Emergent yields pear), plus bracketed hints ("use lettuce & capsicum"). Norms are per-person class norms (eggs 2pc, fruit 1pc, protein 150g, dal 50g, grains 80g, veg 75g, herbs 15g, spices 3g) with h10 at one-third; count items are forced to pieces and garnish is never multiplied to hundreds of grams. Fuzzy match uses ppResolveAll + live-row preference; gram<->piece converted via GPP. Plans re-read live from Emergent (Re-read button + auto-sync), so plan edits flow straight in. Copy-order-list button.
